I live in a small town.
I go to work by bike.
автобус: a big vehicle that carries many people
автобусна зупинка: a place where the bus stops for people
аеропорт: a place where planes take off and land
вокзал; станція: a place where trains or buses stop
вулиця: a road in a town with houses or shops
дорога: a way for cars from one place to another
квиток: a paper or card that lets you travel or go in
магазин: a place where you buy things
мапа, карта: a drawing of streets, roads and places
метро (у Лондоні): the metro; a train under the ground (the Tube in London)
містечко: a place with houses and shops, smaller than a city
парк: a public garden in a town
праворуч; правий: the opposite of left; also correct
таксі: a car you pay to take you somewhere; cab
там; туди: in that place; to that place
тут; сюди: in this place; to this place
